scenes.setting: Outside the City of Silver's gate, ten Beyonders and the Chief with his belt of Demon Hunter bottles set out into the black grass — candles lit, because more than five seconds of darkness has swallowed teammates whole

A cheap East Borough breakfast bought for two: the Azik bounty traced to gang leaders and information dealers, a sighting on Golden Cloak Street with signs of a struggle — and the odd detail that unemployed textile workers keep leaving East Borough for jobs nobody can name

The preserved room on Golden Cloak Street: overturned chairs, and a gray rat whose aura is black-green — its belly rotted open with flowing pus — scuttling up the wall while Old Kohler notices nothing

scenes.setting: A dream invaded: the white cliff and the Stratford bend, the Machinery Hivemind ringing the tomb entrance — and the river writing itself into words. 'Your loyal and humble servant, Arrodes, is here to report to you on the exploration's situation.'
